# awscc_iotsecuretunneling_tunnel (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::IoTSecureTunneling::Tunnel



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A short text description of the tunnel.
- `destination_config` (Attributes) The destination configuration for the tunnel. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination_config))
- `status` (String) The status of the tunnel. Valid values are OPEN and CLOSED.
- `tags` (Attributes List) A collection of tag metadata. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `timeout_config` (Attributes) Timeout configuration for the tunnel. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeout_config))
- `tunnel_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the tunnel.
- `tunnel_id` (String) A unique alpha-numeric tunnel ID.

<a id="nestedatt--destination_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destination_config`

Read-Only:

- `services` (List of String) A list of service names that identify the target application.
- `thing_name` (String) The name of the IoT thing to which you want to connect.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.


<a id="nestedatt--timeout_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeout_config`

Read-Only:

- `max_lifetime_timeout_minutes` (Number) The maximum amount of time (in minutes) a tunnel can remain open.
